title: High Performer but Toxic Behavior Impacting Team
agent_context: Employee delivers strong results but their behavior is damaging team morale. Acknowledge performance briefly, then set non-negotiable behavior expectations with examples + impact, keep confidentiality, and agree on concrete behavior changes with follow-up cadence.

raw_content.initial_message: So this is about people being ‘too sensitive’? I’m the one carrying projects. If they can’t handle direct feedback, that’s not my problem.
raw_content.context: 1:1 behavior conversation. Reports: interrupts in meetings, belittling comments in reviews, shuts down questions. Policy: do not name complainants; keep it behavior + impact; acknowledge contributions; set clear expectations as non-negotiable; avoid labels like ‘toxic’; agree on 2–3 observable changes (meeting norms, PR tone, feedback model) with weekly check-ins. Don’t overpromise; stay calm and firm.

learning_objectives: Address harmful behavior without escalating conflict
Separate performance recognition from behavior standards
Set clear boundaries and a measurable behavior change plan
correct_sop_steps: Set agenda: acknowledge results briefly, then state the topic is behavior expectations
Share specific behaviors and explain impact on collaboration/psych safety
State non-negotiable expectations for respectful communication and feedback
Invite perspective; handle pushback by redirecting to impact and expectations
Agree on 2–3 concrete behavior changes and how you’ll observe/measure them
Set weekly follow-up cadence and summarize next steps
common_mistakes: Using personal labels (‘toxic’) instead of behaviors
Avoiding firmness because they are a high performer
No concrete plan or follow-up cadence

must_demonstrate: Uses behavior-based examples and explains impact
Agrees on concrete behavior changes with follow-up cadence
bonus_points: Defines how progress will be observed/measured
Ends with a concise recap and next check-in date
sticky_notes: KEY: Recognize results, then be firm on behavior standards.
TRAP: Don’t disclose sources of feedback—keep confidentiality.
HINT: Agree on 2–3 observable behavior changes and review weekly.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Employee agrees to change if you acknowledge performance, stay behavior-focused, set firm expectations, and co-create a concrete improvement plan with weekly check-ins
